category: mutable default argument shared between instances; template engine split over a package and a sub-package
issue: Values registered on one template renderer leak into renderers built afterwards. A process that creates a renderer, registers a footer on it, then creates a second renderer for a different page finds the second one already knows the first one's footer, and the one-shot render helper picks it up too. Handing a dictionary of defaults to a renderer is just as bad: the caller's own dictionary quietly grows new keys whenever anything is registered on that renderer. Each renderer should start out with only the values it was actually given.
